integrity: Proved by exact plane-cohomology Frobenius extraction, a Prym isogeny and hypergeometric root separability. Twelve-prime finite replay corroborates but does not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification counts marked coefficient parameters, not curve isomorphism classes. Earlier Newton-polygon possibilities and the elliptic Legendre Deuring polynomial are prior work. Independent audit is outstanding.
title: The reduced superspecial divisor of the cyclic-quartic genus-three pencil at inert primes
